base: Use case: stylized-concept. Office Core game header alternative, panoramic 3:1. Reference 1 supplies ONLY the exact ivory metallic stacked OFFICE / CORE logo with red-blue glowing core inside O and dark red/blue lit office atmosphere. Do NOT copy its generic expression or lineup pose. Reference 2 defines current game's recognizable low-poly human characters and outfit colors; preserve identities, hairstyles and outfits, but accentuate each person's individual brow, face shape and personality. No old block/voxel figures. Cinematic polished low-poly 3D game key art, NOT photoreal humans. Close waist-up or chest-up framing, very prominent faces, cropped lower bodies, not distant full-length figures. Each character carries their own varied weapon naturally. Characters BEHIND foreground logo, logo cannot cover faces. No additional people, text, labels or watermarks. Exact logo text OFFICE CORE. Strong differentiated facial expressions and gestures, avoid everyone smirking or same heroic rifle-across-chest pose.
